description: This file defines data structures related to Kubernetes configuration preferences, including command defaults and command aliases, for the v1alpha1 API version.

classes.name: Preference
classes.description: Stores elements of KubeRC configuration including command defaults and aliases.

classes.name: AliasOverride
classes.description: Defines command alias configurations with optional argument and flag overrides.

classes.name: CommandDefaults
classes.description: Stores default values for specific commands.

classes.name: CommandOptionDefault
classes.description: Stores individual flag default values for commands.
